network.enforcement: No external Lean packages or network operations invoked; OS network isolation is not certified.

manifest_policy: All source/config/schema/claims/TCB/provenance/registry/review inputs selected by frozen policy.inputs. manifest.json excludes itself; input-root.json is a derived root binding and excluded to avoid self-reference. Reports/runs/build outputs are outputs, not inputs.

verified_surface: 19 frozen Lean model propositions and six concrete witnesses
schema/proof-inventory binding, two clean deterministic builds
six final council records and specified model dispatches, not subjective approval as proof
excluded_surface: any product implementation or runtime refinement
full Alloy relational/temporal semantics, parser, printer, SAT4J/Kodkod correctness
serialization/atom semantic identity, auth and witness validator implementation
UI, SQL/RLS, performance, process security and deployment
licensing clearance, market demand and commercial release
closure_boundary.interpretation: VERIFIED means closure only of the frozen finite specification/model surface under declared trust; not assumption-free correctness or production readiness.
